topic: Mutual Fund and ETF Fees and Expenses
subtopic: Acquired Fund Fees and Funds of Funds
source_evidence: if your fund owns shares of another fund, you are paying the fees and expenses of your fund and indirectly paying the fees and expenses of the underlying fund.
question: Misconception: If my fund invests in another fund, I pay only my fund’s own fees—not the underlying fund’s fees.
answer: Correction: You pay your fund’s fees and indirectly pay the fees and expenses of the underlying fund as well. The prospectus fee table reports those underlying-fund costs as Acquired Fund Fees and Expenses.
